paper: Chain-of-Alpha: Unleashing the Power of Large Language Models for Alpha Mining in Quantitative Trading
primary_record_status: withdrawn; official PDF and source endpoints return 404 because the submitter lacked license rights
headline_strategy: Dual-chain LLM factor generation and optimization pipeline producing a selected factor pool for LightGBM return prediction and a Qlib top-k/drop-n portfolio
component_selection_reason: This is the only one of three exact showcased factors that does not require unavailable VWAP. Selection is by JKP input availability, not the paper's displayed RankIC or a new JKP outcome.
source_scope: one showcased generated factor, not either LLM chain, the selected 100-factor pool, LightGBM, or native portfolio

monthly_adapter.amount: JKP dolvol, defined by the supplied JKP source as monthly USD dollar volume
monthly_adapter.operators: five-period average-tie percentile ranks followed by five-period Pearson correlation
monthly_adapter.direction: higher-is-better from the paper's positive displayed RankIC, fixed before evaluation
monthly_adapter.portfolio: common value-weighted long-short deciles for a score-only component
monthly_adapter.costs: common 10 bp one-way primary plus fixed sensitivity cases
monthly_adapter.missing_returns: common zero primary and adverse-100 sensitivity without reranking

adapted: daily CSI-1000 bars to monthly U.S. JKP bars
